bugs.description: The X (Close) button inside the settings panel is disabled (interactable=false) — once the menu is open it can never be closed via its intended control.
The Flee button has no wired click handler — pressing it does nothing (no new encounter begins, no game state changes).
The Floor label is never refreshed — after the hero descends a floor, the shown 'Floor: N' disagrees with the real .floor (the label stays at the pre-descend value).
The Defeated tally (.kills) is not reset on a new run — after the hero dies and Restart begins a fresh run, the count carries over instead of returning to 0.
